summary: Portland, computer science degree, software engineer, strong interest in technology and programming languages (especially Rust and Go), passionate about data management and NoSQL databases, advocate for open-source software, critical of corporate practices in tech, engaged in discussions about social issues and economic policies, values education and lifelong learning, enjoys cooking and food culture, supportive of community and family-oriented values, interested in political and social justice issues, skeptical of mainstream media narratives, believes in the importance of personal data ownership and privacy rights.
